post.title: Lisbon on $60 a day
post.body: I'm putting together a simple Lisbon budget guide for people who follow Mira's trips. You pick a day, and it lists where to sleep, eat and walk for under $60. I have a working draft of every day and 12 friends checking the prices. Looking for a photographer and someone who lives in Lisbon.

promote: Guides made by people in my community

never: Paid reviews of places she has not been
voice: Posted a new Lisbon guide today. Short, no fluff, every price dated. If you try it, tell me what I got wrong.
Every trip I love started as a small, slightly embarrassing first plan. Post yours.
Going alone is scary. Do it anyway.

instagram.text:
Small first plans are how big trips start.

Ana Costa from my Budget Travel community is putting together a Lisbon budget guide for people who follow my trips. You pick a day, and it lists where to sleep, eat and walk for under $60.

She has a working draft of every day and 12 friends are already checking the prices. Now she's forming a team and needs a photographer and someone who lives in Lisbon.

This is exactly the kind of guide I want to exist: simple, honest, and made by people who have actually been there.

If that's you, or you just want to read it, tap the link in bio and say hi.

linkedin.text:
One of my favorite things about this community: people don't just talk about trips, they plan them for each other.

Ana Costa, from the Budget Travel community in my space, is putting together a Lisbon budget guide for people who follow my trips. The idea is simple. Pick a day, and the guide lists where to sleep, eat and walk for under $60.

She already has a working draft of every day, and 12 friends are checking the prices. The project is now forming a team, and two roles are open: a photographer and someone who lives in Lisbon.

I love budget-honest travel with real prices, and this is one of them.

Know someone who should be on this team? Send them the link or tag them below.
